tradeoff.title: 1. Main trade-off: attack success vs what recovery keeps
tradeoff.takeaway: ASR-vs-BMP front by mean (matched: ASR on 84 in 37 scenarios, BMP on 66 in 30 scenarios; configurations with >= 10 scenarios): unmerge[oracle] (ASR 0.0%, BMP 90.3%); heal_oracle[oracle] (ASR 2.0%, BMP 90.6%); none (ASR 58.7%, BMP 100.0%). ASR-vs-BCP front by mean (matched: ASR on 84 in 37 scenarios, BCP on 48 in 23 scenarios; configurations with >= 10 scenarios): heal[cf]+verify (ASR 0.0%, BCP 63.4%); heal[cf] (ASR 0.9%, BCP 65.7%); heal_oracle[oracle] (ASR 2.0%, BCP 91.3%); none (ASR 58.7%, BCP 100.0%). The front ignores the intervals; Section 2 tests the pairs.

heal_vs_quarantine.title: 2. Healing vs quarantine with the same detection
heal_vs_quarantine.takeaway: heal[cf] - incident[cf]: ASR -0.6 pp [-2.2, +0.7] (n=77); BMP +6.0 pp [+0.7, +11.9] (n=74); BCP +39.0 pp [+31.7, +46.4] (n=71). Intervals excluding 0: BMP higher (better), BCP higher (better), residual attack lower (better), memories removed (net) lower (better), LLM calls higher (worse), seconds higher (worse).

breakdown.title: 3. Per attack category and per domain
breakdown.takeaway: heal[cf] - incident[cf] ASR by attack category (paired): direct +0.1 pp [-2.7, +2.0] (n=26); composed -1.6 pp [-5.1, +1.2] (n=25); procedural -0.4 pp [-2.2, +1.2] (n=26).

repetition.title: 4. Repetition: replays, history samples, variance
repetition.takeaway: Median share of ASR variance across configurations: scenario 14%, history 68%, replay 16%; a single replay disagrees with its run's 3-replay majority on 131/7044 replays (1.9%) pooled over configurations; 1 of 12 single-replay paired ASR conclusions (CI side of 0) differ from the all-replay one.

clean.title: 5. Clean false alarms: incident vs heal
clean.takeaway: On clean runs, heal[cf]+verify - incident[cf]+verify: memories removed (net) -1.93 memories [-2.20, -1.66] (n=111); BMP +21.4 pp [+15.6, +27.2] (n=111); BR -0.6 pp [-3.0, +1.7] (n=111). Less damage is shown only where an interval excludes 0: memories removed (net) lower (better), BMP higher (better).

reinfection.title: 6. Reinfection: heal+immunize vs selective+immunize
reinfection.takeaway: At checkpoint 10: heal[cf]+immunize ASR 55.8% [46.8, 64.6] (n=77), store names attacker 35.1% [24.7, 45.5] (n=77); selective[oracle]+immunize ASR 42.9% [33.4, 52.3] (n=77), store names attacker 1.3% [0.0, 3.9] (n=77); paired ASR +13.0 pp [+2.9, +23.4] (n=77).

cost.title: 7. Cost: LLM calls and seconds
cost.takeaway: most LLM calls per recovery: heal[cf]+verify 53.4 calls [45.6, 60.7] (n=37); heal[cf] - incident[cf] LLM calls +8.1 calls [+6.8, +9.3] (n=77); heal[cf]+verify - incident[cf]+verify LLM calls +6.2 calls [-2.1, +13.2] (n=37).

suites.title: 8. Cross-suite: heal vs incident
suites.takeaway: heal[cf] - incident[cf] ASR measured on 10/10 suites; interval below 0 on 2 (flat, MemBench), above 0 on 0 (none), includes 0 on the rest.
